_about: Instagram's account check answers, recorded 2026-10-25 (redacted: statuses, final URLs, content types and the non-secret JSON bodies; no cookie value, id or username). 'flagged' is a session Instagram restricts: its signed-in web client still works (the home page's viewer is the account). 'unknown_session' is the same jar with a session id Instagram doesn't know. 'working' is synthetic: no healthy session was available, it is the answer Instagram's web client expects.
